# design.design_matrix.design_matrix { #fmrimod.design.design_matrix.design_matrix }

```python
design_matrix(x, **kwargs)
```

Extract or construct a design matrix.

This is a `functools.singledispatch` generic function: ``x``
is intentionally ``Any`` because the dispatcher inspects its
runtime type and routes to one of several typed registrations
(``EventModel``, `BaselineModel`, `BaselineTerm`,
`EventTerm`). The registered implementations carry their
own typed signatures.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type   | Description                                   | Default    |
|----------|--------|-----------------------------------------------|------------|
| x        | object | Object to extract design matrix from          | _required_ |
| **kwargs | Any    | Additional arguments depending on object type | `{}`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                  | Description   |
|--------|-----------------------|---------------|
|        | Array or pd.DataFrame | Design matrix |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                | Description                             |
|--------|---------------------|-----------------------------------------|
|        | NotImplementedError | If no method exists for the object type |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # From EventModel
>>> model = event_model("condition + rating", data=df, tr=2.0, n_scans=100)
>>> X = design_matrix(model)
>>>
>>> # From baseline model (when implemented)
>>> baseline = baseline_model(poly(3), sampling_info)
>>> X_baseline = design_matrix(baseline)
```
